comparisons.name: answer-light
comparisons.description: The whole Aqua capture: the Siri window with its shadow, answering with the Weather result of that capture (Memphis, 95°, the hours from 4 PM), scrolled as captured so that the card starts under the top strip. Masked, because they are Apple's artwork and the demo shows abstract placeholders or the library's own drawing in their place: the icon in the card's header, the sun of the summary, the column of hourly glyphs and the orb. The text is not masked here and is set in the fallback font off Apple devices. The window was captured with the desktop picture blended into its materials, so the example puts a grey element with the capture's aqua cast behind the window and sets --mac-siri-card-glow for the light in the card.

comparisons.name: answer-light-layout
comparisons.description: As answer-light with the text masked too (the card's title, the city, the three condition lines and the temperature, the hour labels and the degrees), because it is set in the fallback font off Apple devices. Scores the window alone: chrome, edge, shadow, strips, lines, the close and help buttons, and the card with its corners, header band and fill.

comparisons.name: answer-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Dark Aqua capture: the same window answering with the Weather result of that capture (Memphis, 73°, the hours from 12 PM). Masked as in answer-light: the header icon, the sun of the summary, the column of hourly glyphs and the orb, which are Apple's artwork. The text is not masked. The element behind the window and --mac-siri-card-glow stand in for this capture's desktop picture, with warm and pink casts.

comparisons.name: answer-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As answer-dark with the text masked too, to score the window alone. The mean difference is higher than in Aqua because the casts of this desktop picture are stronger and the gradients that stand in for it follow them only roughly.

comparisons.name: answer-listening-light
comparisons.description: Not a comparison with a capture: no screenshot shows Siri listening. A short window that waits with Siri's own prompt, after a real click on the orb, Aqua; three pixels show that the click put the window into its listening state.

pixels.note: middle of the waveform's centre bar: the middle stop of its gradient (--mac-siri-orb-blue in the library's siri.tokens.css). Before the click this is the white core of the orb. The listening state is inferred and the waveform is the library's own drawing.

between the third and fourth bars of the waveform, which are 3 pt wide and 3 pt apart: the chrome, rgb(30 30 30) at 70% over #757575 (spec: siri, Window chrome, measured #383838). Before the click the orb's blue light is drawn here.
the chrome of the top strip does not change (spec: siri, Window chrome, measured #383838)
